title: San Diego Automotive Museum

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The San Diego Automotive Museum houses a multi-million-dollar collection of cars, motorcycles, and memorabilia sure to make any event a special one. The Hall of Fame offers a bird's-eye view of the museum, showcasing the entire exhibit floor. The Grove is a private, park-like setting that offers a unique view of the Cabrillo Bridge. Perfect for a small birthday party. Exclusive use of the Kid's Corner, admission to the Museum, decorations and a diecast toy car for each child are included. Available 10:30am-12:30pm or 2:00pm-4:00pm. Some Blackout dates

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The San Diego Automotive Museum in Balboa Park offers hands-on school programs where students explore the science, engineering, and design of transportation. Through interactive workshops and guided tours, students connect classroom lessons to real-world experiences. Our school programs, for students from TK to 8th grade, align with Common Core and NGSS standards. Students learn how vehicles move, how engineering solves problems, and how transportation shapes our world. STEM activities with real vehicles and artifacts help students understand motion, mechanics, and innovation while building teamwork and problem-solving skills.
